cohort: Newborns born at Rainbow Children's Hospital, Banjara Hills, Hyderabad, India between September 2019 and April 2021.
finding: Timely weaned infants had larger head circumferences at 6 months and 1 year, although overall growth differences compared to early weaned infants were not clinically significant.
mod_finding: There was a statistically significant difference in weaning practices and mode of delivery (p = 0.003).
